THE HAGUE WORKFLOW
How Hague Export works, dock to door

Cross-border agro trade is traditionally run on WhatsApp chats and blind trust. We replaced it with a disciplined, documented flow — so a buyer in Hamburg and an exporter in Kano can transact like they've worked together for years.

FOUR STEPS
The standard trade flow
01
Search & Verify

Filter verified commodity listings by origin, grade and supplier badge. Every exporter is screened through our 4-tier trust system.

02
Submit RFQ

Send a structured Request for Quotation with volume, Incoterm, destination port and inspection requirements — in under 2 minutes.

03
Negotiate & Contract

Compare competing supplier quotes side-by-side, chat directly, and lock terms with Hague-standard sales contract templates.

04
Inspect & Ship

Third-party inspection (SGS / Bureau Veritas) at loading, documents checked, cargo tracked to your destination port.

Our verification office in Lagos runs a documented audit trail on every supplier — re-validated on a rolling basis.

NEPC license check

Bank & TIN match

Corporate bank account and Tax Identification Number cross-matched to the registered entity.

Physical site inspection

Hague field officers audit warehouses, processing lines and QC procedures at Gold tier and above.

Trade reference calls

Past buyers referenced for fulfilled volumes, quality consistency and dispute behaviour.

Sanctions & AML screen

Entities screened against global sanctions, PEP and adverse-media databases before badge award.

FAQ
Membership questions, answered
When does billing start?
Phase 1 is completely free for all tiers. Paid plans activate with the production launch; anyone who selects a paid plan during the preview gets 3 months free at launch.
Can I switch between buyer and exporter roles?
Yes — many Nigerian trading houses both buy and sell. Open a second workspace from your account menu, or contact the trade desk to enable a dual-role account.
What payment methods will Corporate & Enterprise support?
Cards, bank transfer (USD and NGN), and for Enterprise, monthly invoicing. Trade escrow (Phase 2) will additionally support LC-adjacent milestone releases.
Does my subscription include verification?
Professional includes Silver document verification; Corporate includes the Gold site inspection; Enterprise fast-tracks the Platinum certification audit. Upgrades never repeat checks already completed.
Can I cancel anytime?
Annual plans can be cancelled with effect at the end of the term; downgrades take effect immediately and your data (RFQs, quotes, listings) is retained for 24 months.

ABOUT HAGUE EXPORT
Built in Lagos. Trusted from Hamburg to Ho Chi Minh City.

Hague Export is the trade infrastructure product of Hague Digital Solutions (RC-3789349). We started as commodity brokers and learned the hard way that African agro trade doesn't lack supply or demand — it lacks trust infrastructure. So we built it.

Our Mission

To make sourcing verified African commodities as safe and structured as buying from a domestic supplier — by combining rigorous verification, disciplined trade workflows and a human trade desk that answers on WhatsApp.

Our Vision

A continent where every legitimate exporter — from a Kano sesame cooperative to a Cross River cocoa estate — can reach global buyers on the strength of a verified track record, not connections.
